FN-6YSY43Z-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 351
Committee: Commerce and Small Business Sponsor: Representative Mike Shaw
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/02/2026
House Bill 351 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Attorney General by an
undetermined amount to provide for the enforcement of the provisions in this bill which could
be offset by fines assessed pursuant to this bill, not to exceed $15,000 per violation.
